name: Lunch, with Extras
jem_summary: Eat from a loaded Transmutation Lunch Bag and receive at least one additional stored effect.

pages.title: Lunch, with Extras
pages.text: Eat from a loaded Transmutation Lunch Bag and receive at least one additional stored effect.

pages.title: Lunch, with Extras
pages.text: Apply extra effects from a portable food supply.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: This version has 16 slots. It consumes the first food or potion and can add effects sampled from up to three others; an extra effect can consume one additional item.

pages.title: Store kitchen supplies
pages.text: The Enamel Basin stores oil and oils a Kitchen Shovel. A Fruit Basket carries produce; the Lunch Bag consumes its own supplies and follows separate effect rules.

pages.title: Combine stored meal effects
pages.text: Version 1.4.1 has 16 slots: it consumes the first available food or potion, then samples effects from up to three other supplies. An extra effect can consume one additional item; later-version rules do not apply.
